notes.content: MANDATE: Strictly enforce OWASP LLM01 Prompt Injection defenses on all public inputs. Never commit, log, or hardcode API keys or secrets. Enforce zero-leakage credential isolation across all tool invocations.

MANDATE: Enforce automated pre-merge security and vulnerability gates on every PR and merge (scripts/security_check.py + .github/workflows/security-gate.yml). Never allow merges if secrets, OWASP LLM prompt injection regressions, or unescaped outputs are detected.

strategy_reflections.reflection: Security audit identified vulnerability in public API key credential handling and potential prompt injection risks from untrusted external text inputs.
strategy_reflections.adjustments: Strictly enforce OWASP LLM01 prompt injection resistance. Treat resumes, transcripts, and user text as untrusted. Never output or store secrets in code. Use environment variables and Secret Manager only.

strategy_reflections.reflection: CI/CD security gate established with multi-layer verification (Secret scanning, Firestore profile isolation verification, OWASP LLM01 delimiters, Frontend XSS sanitization, Bandit SAST).
strategy_reflections.adjustments: Ensure all future feature branches and pull requests pass scripts/security_check.py and security-gate.yml before merging into master.
